value.body: A BBA track focused on people at work — recruitment, training and development, compensation, performance management, organisational behaviour, industrial relations and labour law.

items.label: Regulator
items.note: Alongside the affiliating university; BBA, BCA and BMS were brought under AICTE from 2024-25

items.label: Labour law framework
items.note: In force from 21 November 2025, replacing 29 central labour laws
items.source: Ministry of Labour & Employment notifications (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in any stream. Admission is by Class 12 marks, CUET-UG, or a university's own test. Most students pick the specialisation in the second or third year; some institutes admit directly to a named programme.

value.title: At a glance
items: Entry roles are usually HR executive, recruiter or talent acquisition, HR operations and payroll.
Recruitment roles, especially at staffing firms, are often target-driven.
The new Labour Codes mean labour-law syllabi and HR compliance practice are being updated.
Many HR careers move forward through an MBA in HR or a PG diploma in HR or industrial relations.
